title: Homogeneous coefficient homomorphisms and unique fraction charts
statement: Let f:W→T be a scheme morphism, A a quasi-coherent graded commutative O_T-algebra, L an invertible O_W-module, and psi_n:f^*A_n→L^n degreewise linear maps preserving the tensor unit and products. For every affine V, d>0 and a in A_d(V), let G_a be the generator open of psi(a) [def-trf-line-proj-fraction-chart-data]. There is a unital ring homomorphism A(V)_(a),0→O_W(G_a) characterized by rho(b/a^m)psi(a)^m=psi(b)|G_a for every m≥0 and b in A_(md)(V). It induces a unique chart G_a→Spec A(V)_(a),0; on every smaller source open its fraction equation characterizes the restricted chart. In any frame e of L with psi(a)=alpha_a e^d, G_a intersect B=D(alpha_a), and rho(b/a^m)alpha_a^m=alpha_b whenever psi(b)=alpha_b e^(md). Tensor powers, scalar maps and the fraction equation commute with source restriction. The construction includes m=0 and requires no reducedness or finite generation.

proof.text: Use the ambient generating-locus membership and local-to-global free-generator theorems from [lem-trf-line-proj-generation-locus], imported rather than duplicated. The image section s of a is a free generator on its generator open G: the defining local generator neighbourhoods cover G, and the free-generator property is local. Tensor products and the tensor-power comparison isomorphisms show s^m is a basis, including the tensor unit for m=0. In a frame e on B, unique coefficients in e^n give additive maps on each homogeneous piece. The unit and product laws identify their value on 1 and products, so the graded direct-sum universal property makes them a ring homomorphism phi:A(V) to O(B).

proof.text: On B contained in G, phi(a) times the frame e^d is a basis. The ratio between two bases is a unit, so phi(a) is invertible. Extend phi to the ordinary localization A(V)[1/a] and restrict to the degree-zero homogeneous subring. The localization fraction relation gives rho(b/a^m) phi(a)^m=phi(b); multiplying by e^(md) gives the tensor fraction formula. This does not assume a is a non-zero-divisor.

proof.text: Every homogeneous fraction has a representative b/a^m, with b corresponding to an actual homogeneous sheaf section by the direct-sum decomposition. Assign it the unique coefficient of psi(b) in s^m on G. On every frame open this coefficient equals the local localization homomorphism by cancellation. It is therefore independent of the representative; the sheaf condition proves all ring laws locally. The affine-spectrum adjunction constructs the chart from this global ring homomorphism. All smaller-source uniqueness follows by cancelling s^m for every homogeneous fraction.

proof.text: Restriction commutes with tensor powers and scalar maps, so the fraction equation persists under source restriction. In any frame, substitute psi(a)=alpha_a e^d and psi(b)=alpha_b e^(md), then cancel the frame to obtain rho(b/a^m)alpha_a^m=alpha_b. A section alpha_a e^d generates exactly on D(alpha_a): the ratio of bases is a unit in one direction, and alpha_a is invertible on its basic open in the other.

theorem exists_lineProj_fraction_coefficient_hom {W T : Scheme.{u}} (f : W ⟶ T)
    (A : RelativeProjAlgebra T) (L : W.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (ψ : ∀ n : ℕ, (tensorPullback f).obj (A.piece n) ⟶ L.tensorPow n)
    (hunit : ∀ (V : T.Opens) (r : Γ(T, V)),
      lineProjImage f A L ψ V 0 (A.graded.unit.val.app (op V) (unitSectionsEquiv V r)) =
        unitSectionsEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f.app V r))
    (hmul : ∀ (V : T.Opens) (m n : ℕ) (a : Γ(A.piece m, V)) (b : Γ(A.piece n, V)),
      lineProjImage f A L ψ V (m + n) (A.graded.mul m n V a b) =
        (L.tensorPowAddIso m n).inv.app (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
          (tmulSection (lineProjImage f A L ψ V m a) (lineProjImage f A L ψ V n b)))
    (V : T.affineOpens) (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (a : Γ(A.piece d, V.1)) :
    ∃ ρ : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (A.grade V) (lineProjElement A V d a).val →+*
        Γ(W, lineProjGeneratorOpen f A L ψ V d a),
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (b : Γ(A.piece (m • d), V.1)),
        ρ (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (A.grade V)
          (lineProjElement A V d a).property m
          (lineProjElement A V (m • d) b).val
          (lineProjElement A V (m • d) b).property) •
          lineProjPower L (lineProjGeneratorOpen f A L ψ V d a) d
            ((L.tensorPow d).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op
              (lineProjImage f A L ψ V.1 d a)) m =
          (L.tensorPow (m • d)).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op
            (lineProjImage f A L ψ V.1 (m • d) b)
